column2: 2: 1;6 1;ulūkhalamusalaṁ śūrpaṁ prakṣālitaṁ carmaṇyādhāya ulūkhalamusalaṁ ca śūrpaṁ ca prakṣālayet |;
2: 1;6 5;avaghnaṁśca haviṣkṛtā mantreṇa haviṣkṛd ā dravehīti triḥ arthābhidhānāt |;

2: 1;6 11;carmaṇyādhāyeti vacanaṁ carmaṇi haviḥsaṁskārasya vrīhīniti darśapūrṇamāsayor nirvāpagrahaṇaṁ tasya sarvahaviḥsampratyayārthatvāt paścādagnervāgyataḥ saṁviśati ityata ārabhya vāgyamo haviṣkṛdehīti haviṣkriyākartṛtvāt |;
2: 1;7 1;avadṛtya suphalīkṛtān kṛtvā triḥ prakṣālya taṇḍulān agne avahatya ā taṇḍulanirvṛtteḥ |;
2: 1;7 4;prakṣālyodakena taṇḍulān agne carurityagnau caruṁ carugrahaṇaṁ navakakharparakapālānāṁ mā bhūt |;
2: 1;10 1;pari tvāgne puraṁ vayam iti triḥparyagni karoti |;
2: 1;17 1;darbhamuṣṭimabhyukṣya paścādagneḥ prāgagraṁ yo muṣṭiḥ prathamo lūnas taṁ paścādagneḥ pūrvāgraṁ nivṛttacodanāllavanakāle prathamasya muṣṭeḥ pṛthag lavanakāle vacana ihāvaśyagrahaṇāt |;
2: 1;18 1;darbhāṇāmapādāya ṛṣīṇāṁ prastaro.si iti darbhebhyaḥ paribhojanīyebhyaḥ apādāya darbhān brahmaṇaḥ āsanaṁ brahmāsanam |;
